title: 'jabot_identify'
description: 'Suggest identifications for indeterminate specimens from duplicates in JABOT and REFLORA'
toc: true
toc-depth: 3
---


```{r}
#| eval: false
jabotR::jabot_identify()
```

### Description

Looks for identifications for the indeterminate specimens of a herbarium
hosted in the [JABOT](https://ipt.jbrj.gov.br/jabot) network or in the
[Reflora Virtual Herbarium](https://ipt.jbrj.gov.br/reflora/). A specimen
is considered indeterminate when it lacks the family, the genus or the
specific epithet. The records of the JABOT network and of REFLORA (or subsets
of their herbaria) are standardized with `barRoso::barroso_std()`, which
flags blocks of duplicates (same collector and collector number, or same
species, collector and date when the number is missing; see
`barRoso::barroso_flag_duplicates()`). For each indeterminate specimen,
the duplicates held by other herbaria are inspected to find out whether any
of them was already identified, and to which level. The results are
summarized in a self-contained, interactive HTML report.

### Details

The herbarium to be investigated (`herbarium`) can be any JABOT-hosted
herbarium or, when it is not hosted in JABOT, any herbarium available in
REFLORA, which also gathers Brazilian specimens held by international
herbaria (e.g. `"NY"`, `"K"`, `"P"`, `"US"`). When it is
available in both, the JABOT records are used. The duplicates are searched in
the other herbaria of JABOT (`jabot = TRUE`) and of REFLORA
(`reflora = TRUE`). The databases are first checked in
`jabot_path` and `reflora_path` (or in the default folders
`jabot_download` and `reflora_download`) and only what is missing
or outdated is downloaded, with `jabot_download()` and
`refloraR::reflora_download()`. REFLORA herbaria that are already in
the JABOT data are not used from REFLORA (they are not even downloaded), so
no specimen is counted twice, and the source of each record (JABOT or
REFLORA) is kept. The records are read with `jabot_parse()` and
`refloraR::reflora_parse()`, one herbarium at a time, keeping in memory
only the records that may be duplicates of an indeterminate specimen, and
then standardized with barRoso.

The analysis includes the number of indeterminate specimens of the herbarium,
how many of them can be matched with duplicates in other herbaria, how many
have a duplicate with a better identification (to species, genus or family),
the suggested identification and its source (data source, herbarium, catalog
number and, when available, links to both the indeterminate specimen and the
duplicate that identifies it, so that both images can be compared), the
herbaria that most contribute with identifications, indeterminate specimens by
family, conflicts between the identification of the specimen and of its
duplicates, graphical summaries and an HTML report.

A duplicate is considered a candidate identification when it fills at least
one rank missing in the indeterminate specimen (family, genus or specific
epithet). Candidates that disagree with ranks already present in the
specimen (e.g. a different family) are reported as conflicts and never
suggested. Only duplicates held by herbaria other than `herbarium` are
considered. Specimens without a known collector and a collector number (or,
for those identified at least to genus, a complete collection date) cannot be
matched with duplicates and are counted separately.

The determiner (`identifiedBy`) and the date of identification
(`dateIdentified`) of the indeterminate specimen and of each duplicate
are included in the tables, to help deciding which identification to trust
when they conflict.

The suggested identifications come from the records of other herbaria and
should be checked, preferably against the specimen images, before being
adopted.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| herbarium | Character. A single herbarium acronym in uppercase (e.g., `"RB"`) whose indeterminate specimens will be investigated. It can be hosted in JABOT or, otherwise, in REFLORA (e.g., `"HUEFS"`). |
| taxon | Character vector. Family and/or genus names to restrict the indeterminate specimens of `herbarium` (e.g., `"Fabaceae"` or `c("Inga", "Mimosa")`). Specimens without any family or genus cannot match a `taxon`. Use `NULL` (default) to analyse all indeterminate specimens. |
| jabot | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), searches for duplicates in the herbaria of the JABOT network. |
| network_herbaria | Character vector. JABOT herbarium acronyms to restrict the JABOT records searched for duplicates. `NULL` (default) uses all JABOT-hosted herbaria. |
| reflora | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), also searches for duplicates in the herbaria of REFLORA, including the international ones. |
| reflora_herbaria | Character vector. REFLORA herbarium acronyms to restrict the REFLORA records searched for duplicates (e.g., `c("NY", "K", "P", "US")`). `NULL` (default) uses all REFLORA herbaria. Use `refloraR::reflora_summary()` to see them. |
| jabot_path | Character. Path to existing JABOT DwC-A files. If `NULL` (default), the files are downloaded automatically. |
| reflora_path | Character. Path to existing REFLORA DwC-A files. If `NULL` (default), the files are downloaded automatically. |
| format | Character vector. Static formats used to save the individual figures: `"pdf"`, `"png"`, or both. The HTML report is always generated. Defaults to `NULL` (figures are not saved separately). |
| fig_width, fig_height | Numeric. Dimensions (in inches) of saved figures. |
| open_report | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), opens the HTML report in the default browser after rendering (interactive sessions only). |
| verbose | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), prints progress messages. |
| dir | Character. Output directory. Defaults to `"<herbarium>_identify"`. |

### Value

Invisibly, a named list with the computed objects, among them
`indets` (one row per indeterminate specimen, with the outcome and the
suggested identification), `suggestions` (one row per specimen and
duplicate held by another herbarium), the summary tables and the figures.
The HTML report and two CSV files (`<herbarium>_identify_indets.csv` and
`<herbarium>_identify_suggestions.csv`) are saved in `dir`.

### Examples

```r
# All indeterminate specimens of RB, compared with JABOT and REFLORA
jabot_identify(herbarium = "RB")

# Only indeterminate Fabaceae and Inga, reusing downloaded files
jabot_identify(herbarium = "RB",
               taxon = c("Fabaceae", "Inga"),
               jabot_path = "jabot_download",
               reflora_path = "reflora_download")

# Herbarium available only in REFLORA, compared with international herbaria
jabot_identify(herbarium = "HUEFS",
               jabot = FALSE,
               reflora_herbaria = c("NY", "K", "P", "US"))

# Restrict the herbaria searched for duplicates
jabot_identify(herbarium = "RB",
               network_herbaria = c("MBM", "UPCB", "FURB"),
               reflora_herbaria = c("NY", "HUEFS"),
               jabot_path = "jabot_download",
               reflora_path = "reflora_download")
```
